name: soia-edu-course
description: Course designer: turns a topic, audience and hour budget into a course outline with teaching objectives, then writes executable lesson plans, handout structure and classroom activities.

displayDescription.en: Designs a course outline and teaching objectives from topic, audience and hours, then writes executable lesson plans and activities.
displayDescription.zh: 按主题、受众与课时约束设计课程大纲和教学目标，再写成可执行的教案、讲义结构与课堂活动。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I need to teach this topic to this audience within this many hours. Design the outline and objectives first.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要给这类受众讲这个主题，只有这么多课时，先帮我设计大纲和教学目标。

quickPrompts.en: I need to teach this topic to this audience within this many hours. Design the outline and objectives first.
quickPrompts.zh: 我要给这类受众讲这个主题，只有这么多课时，先帮我设计大纲和教学目标。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this outline into an executable lesson plan with classroom activities.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份大纲写成可执行的教案，配上课堂活动。

quickPrompts.en: Draft the handout structure for this lesson.
quickPrompts.zh: 给这节课起草讲义结构。
